title: Orsen and the Protocol
author: Bram Ishikawa
blurb: Mara Underhill, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
